Members

esc

HTML-escapes every byte of user-originated text before emission.

(module scope)

Recursively lists .scss files under dir (self-similar tree walk).

classify

Classifies the code line that follows a /// block into the sassdoc item taxonomy and extracts the declared name.

parseBlock

Splits a /// block into prose lines and structured @tag lines. Supported tags: @param, @return, @output, @deprecated — everything else is preserved as a raw tag line so nothing is dropped.

parseFile

Parses one .scss file into its documented item list.

renderItem

Renders one documented item as an escaped definition block.
